title: Members
description: Manage staff access and invitations for this company.
inviteDescription: Choose the roles this person needs in your company.
name: Name
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it.
once: This link is shown only once. Copy it before closing this panel.
linkUnavailable: This invitation was already created. Its link is no longer available. Ask your administrator to resend the invitation.
not_configured: Email not sent: email delivery is not configured for this environment. Share this link with the person.
failed: Email could not be sent. Share this link with the person.
INVITATION_EXISTS: A pending invitation already exists for this email.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the email and selected roles, then try again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
UNAVAILABLE: We could not reach Aqarak. Check your connection and try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: These details differ from the previous attempt. Close this panel and start a new invitation.
invitationDescription: Review the company and roles before accepting.
expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the company administrator for a new invitation.
accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
revoked: This invitation has been revoked. Contact the company administrator.
INVITATION_NOT_PENDING: This invitation is no longer pending. Refresh its details or contact the company administrator.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that email to accept it.
ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP_ELSEWHERE: This person has an active staff membership in another company. That membership must be suspended or removed first.
PARTY_ALREADY_LINKED: This invitation is already linked to an account. Contact the company administrator.
SESSION_INVALID: Your session has ended. Sign in again to accept this invitation.
storageUnavailable: Allow session storage in this browser to keep your invitation while signing in, then reopen the invitation link.
signOut: Sign out to use another account
reasonRequired: Enter a reason of 1 to 2000 characters.
removeConsequence: The person loses access to this company at once; their account remains.
VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this member while you were working. Reload to see the latest roles.
LAST_ADMINISTRATOR: This company must keep at least one active administrator.
NOT_FOUND: This member or invitation is no longer available.
revokeDescription: The invitation link will stop working immediately.
resendDescription: Create a new invitation link. The previous link will stop working.
